newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firm on Asia arb, French strike.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firm on Asia arb, French strike.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were firmer on Thursday with traders mildly bullish on an arb to Asia and a deepening refinery strike in France.
"It's getting tempting," a trader said of rising Singapore gas oil prices, adding the arb was focusing attention on an Indian Oil Corp gas oil tender expected out late on Friday.

Strong Chinese demand has pushed Singapore gas oil prices to a level which attracts European sellers just as the Elf refinery strike shows signs of spreading. Analysts say the stoppage has caused a shortfall of gas oil of up to 140,000 tonnes so far.
Elf was seen buying gas oil cargoes in NWE and looking for a vessel in the Black Sea.
Dec IPE futures rose $4.25 to $228.25 a tonne, helped higher by stronger Brent crude futures.
Refinery grade heating oil cargoes were up 25/50 cents to Dec IPE +$4/5 for prompt, with Dec 15-30 at Jan IPE +$6/7. Low sulphur diesel was steady at +$17/18.
Heating oil barge premiums slid in line with higher futures, being done at done at flat and Dec IPE +$0.25, 75 cents lower as traders unwound positions ahead of the screen expiry.
